questions: Does streaming egress get PII-sanitized like the non-streaming path?
Can a client distinguish completion from mid-stream rejection/error?

findings.claim: infer_stream streams raw u32 tokens; egress sanitize_output(&str) never runs -> PII bypass
terminal is is_final/sender-drop only; completion vs rejection vs error indistinguishable
faithful detokenization for sanitization couples to B-28 real tokenizer

decision: detokenize-in-runtime ADOPTED; client-side REJECTED; split B-24a(terminal)/B-24b(sanitize); resequence B-28 before B-24b
